versos.grego: Οὗτος γὰρ ὁ Μελχισέδεκ, βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ἱερεὺς τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ Ὑψίστου, ὁ συναντήσας Ἀβραὰμ ὑποστρέφοντι ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς τῶν βασιλέων καὶ εὐλογήσας αὐτόν,

controles.web: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
controles.kjv: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
controles.livre: Porque este Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, sacerdote do Deus Altíssimo, o qual se encontrou com Abraão, que estava retornando da matança dos reis, e o abençoou;

versos.grego: ᾧ καὶ δεκάτην ἀπὸ πάντων ἐμέρισεν Ἀβραάμ, πρῶτον μὲν ἑρμηνευόμενος βασιλεὺς δικαιοσύνης, ἔπειτα δὲ καὶ βασιλεὺς Σαλήμ, ὅ ἐστιν βασιλεὺς εἰρήνης,

controles.web: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;
controles.kjv: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
controles.livre: a quem também Abraão deu o dízimo de tudo; primeiramente significa Rei de justiça, e depois também rei de Salém, que é, rei de paz;

versos.grego: ἀπάτωρ, ἀμήτωρ, ἀγενεαλόγητος, μήτε ἀρχὴν ἡμερῶν μήτε ζωῆς τέλος ἔχων, ἀφωμοιωμένος δὲ τῷ Υἱῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ, μένει ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸ διηνεκές.

controles.web: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
controles.kjv: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
controles.livre: sem pai, sem mãe, sem genealogia, sem ter princípio de dias, nem fim de vida; porém, sendo feito semelhante ao Filho de Deus, permanece sacerdote para sempre.

versos.grego: Θεωρεῖτε δὲ πηλίκος οὗτος ᾧ δεκάτην Ἀβραὰμ ἔδωκεν ἐκ τῶν ἀκροθινίων ὁ πατριάρχης.

controles.web: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
controles.kjv: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
controles.livre: Considerai, pois, como ele era grande, a quem até o patriarca Abraão deu o dízimo dos despojos.

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ μὲν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Λευεὶ τὴν ἱερατείαν λαμβάνοντες ἐντολὴν ἔχουσιν ἀποδεκατοῖν τὸν λαὸν κατὰ τὸν νόμον, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν, καίπερ ἐξεληλυθότας ἐκ τῆς ὀσφύος Ἀβραάμ·

controles.web: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
controles.kjv: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
controles.livre: E, realmente, os que dentre os filhos de Levi recebem o sacerdócio têm ordem, segundo a Lei, de receberem os dízimos do povo, isto é, dos seus irmãos, mesmo sendo eles também descendentes de Abraão.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ μὴ γενεαλογούμενος ἐξ αὐτῶν δεδεκάτωκεν Ἀβραάμ, καὶ τὸν ἔχοντα τὰς ἐπαγγελίας εὐλόγηκεν.

controles.web: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
controles.kjv: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
controles.livre: Mas aquele que não é contado na genealogia deles recebeu dízimos de Abraão, e abençoou ao que tinha as promessas.

versos.grego: χωρὶς δὲ πάσης ἀντιλογίας τὸ ἔλαττον ὑπὸ τοῦ κρείττονος εὐλογεῖται.

controles.web: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
controles.kjv: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
controles.livre: Ora, sem contradição alguma, o menor é abençoado pelo maior.

versos.grego: καὶ ὧδε μὲν δεκάτας ἀποθνῄσκοντες ἄνθρωποι λαμβάνουσιν, ἐκεῖ δὲ μαρτυρούμενος ὅτι ζῇ.

controles.web: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
controles.kjv: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
controles.livre: Em um caso, homens mortais recebem dízimos; mas no outro, aquele de quem se dá testemunho de que vive.

versos.grego: καὶ ὡς ἔπος εἰπεῖν, δι’ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Λευεὶς ὁ δεκάτας λαμβάνων δεδεκάτωται·

controles.web: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
controles.kjv: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
controles.livre: E, por assim dizer, até Levi, que recebe os dízimos, pagou dízimos através de Abraão;

versos.grego: ἔτι γὰρ ἐν τῇ ὀσφύϊ τοῦ πατρὸς ἦν ὅτε συνήντησεν αὐτῷ Μελχισέδεκ.

controles.web: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
controles.kjv: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
controles.livre: pois ele ainda estava no corpo  de seu ancestral  quando Melquisedeque se encontrou com ele.

versos.grego: Εἰ μὲν οὖν τελείωσις διὰ τῆς Λευειτικῆς ἱερωσύνης ἦν, ὁ λαὸς γὰρ ἐπ’ αὐτῆς νενομοθέτηται, τίς ἔτι χρεία κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἕτερον ἀνίστασθαι ἱερέα καὶ οὐ κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Ἀαρὼν λέγεσθαι;

controles.web: Now if there were perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
controles.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
controles.livre: Portanto, se a perfeição tivesse sido de fato pelo sacerdócio Levítico (pois com base nele o povo recebeu a Lei), que mais necessidade havia de se levantar outro Sacerdote segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque, e não ser chamado segundo a ordem de Arão?

versos.grego: μετατιθεμένης γὰρ τῆς ἱερωσύνης ἐξ ἀνάγκης καὶ νόμου μετάθεσις γίνεται.

controles.web: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
controles.kjv: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
controles.livre: Pois, ao se mudar o sacerdócio, necessariamente também se faz mudança de Lei.

versos.grego: ἐφ’ ὃν γὰρ λέγεται ταῦτα, φυλῆς ἑτέρας μετέσχηκεν, ἀφ’ ἧς οὐδεὶς προσέσχηκεν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ·

controles.web: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
controles.kjv: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
controles.livre: Porque aquele de quem estas coisas são ditas pertence a outra tribo, da qual ninguém serviu ao altar;

versos.grego: πρόδηλον γὰρ ὅτι ἐξ Ἰούδα ἀνατέταλκεν ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν, εἰς ἣν φυλὴν περὶ ἱερέων οὐδὲν Μωϋσῆς ἐλάλησεν.

controles.web: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
controles.kjv: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
controles.livre: visto ser evidente que o nosso Senhor é procedente de Judá, tribo da qual Moisés nada falou a respeito de sacerdotes.

versos.grego: Καὶ περισσότερον ἔτι κατάδηλόν ἐστιν, εἰ κατὰ τὴν ὁμοιότητα Μελχισέδεκ ἀνίσταται ἱερεὺς ἕτερος,

controles.web: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
controles.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
controles.livre: E isso ainda é muito mais evidente se, à semelhança de Melquisedeque, levanta-se outro sacerdote,

versos.grego: ὃς οὐ κατὰ νόμον ἐντολῆς σαρκίνης γέγονεν ἀλλὰ κατὰ δύναμιν ζωῆς ἀκαταλύτου.

controles.web: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:
controles.kjv: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
controles.livre: que foi constituído, não conforme a Lei de um mandamento carnal, mas sim, conforme o poder de uma vida indestrutível.

versos.grego: μαρτυρεῖται γὰρ ὅτι Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

controles.web: for it is testified,  “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
controles.kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
controles.livre: Pois assim dá-se testemunho: Tu és Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.

versos.grego: ἀθέτησις μὲν γὰρ γίνεται προαγούσης ἐντολῆς διὰ τὸ αὐτῆς ἀσθενὲς καὶ ἀνωφελές,

controles.web: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
controles.kjv: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
controles.livre: Porque há uma revogação do mandamento anterior, por causa da sua fraqueza e inutilidade,

versos.grego: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐτελείωσεν ὁ νόμος, ἐπεισαγωγὴ δὲ κρείττονος ἐλπίδος, δι’ ἧς ἐγγίζομεν τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
controles.kjv: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
controles.livre: pois a Lei não tornou perfeito nada. Porém, uma esperança melhor é introduzida, e por meio dela nos aproximamos de Deus.

versos.grego: Καὶ καθ’ ὅσον οὐ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας, —οἱ μὲν γὰρ χωρὶς ὁρκωμοσίας εἰσὶν ἱερεῖς γεγονότες,

controles.web: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
controles.kjv: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
controles.livre: E isso não foi feito sem juramento (pois os outros se tornaram sacerdotes sem juramento,

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ μετὰ ὁρκωμοσίας διὰ τοῦ λέγοντος πρὸς αὐτόν Ὤμοσεν Κύριος, καὶ οὐ μεταμεληθήσεται Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·

controles.web: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him,  “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
controles.kjv: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
controles.livre: mas ele foi estabelecido com um juramento daquele que lhe disse: O Senhor jurou, e não se arrependerá: Tu és Sacerdote para sempre  ).

versos.grego: —κατὰ τοσοῦτο καὶ κρείττονος διαθήκης γέγονεν ἔγγυος Ἰησοῦς.

controles.web: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.
controles.kjv: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
controles.livre: Assim, Jesus foi feito fiador de um pacto  ainda melhor.

versos.grego: Καὶ οἱ μὲν πλείονές εἰσιν γεγονότες ἱερεῖς διὰ τὸ θανάτῳ κωλύεσθαι παραμένειν·

controles.web: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
controles.kjv: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
controles.livre: Dos outros, são muitos os que se tornaram sacerdotes, pois pela morte foram impedidos de continuar;

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ διὰ τὸ μένειν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀπαράβατον ἔχει τὴν ἱερωσύνην·

controles.web: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
controles.kjv: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
controles.livre: mas ele, porque permanece para sempre, tem um sacerdócio definitivo.

versos.grego: ὅθεν καὶ σῴζειν εἰς τὸ παντελὲς δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους δι’ αὐτοῦ τῷ Θεῷ, πάντοτε ζῶν εἰς τὸ ἐντυγχάνειν ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
controles.kjv: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
controles.livre: Portanto, ele também pode salvar de maneira completa os que se aproximam de Deus por meio dele, visto que ele vive para sempre para interceder por eles.

versos.grego: Τοιοῦτος γὰρ ἡμῖν καὶ ἔπρεπεν ἀρχιερεύς, ὅσιος, ἄκακος, ἀμίαντος, κεχωρισμένος ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτωλῶν, καὶ ὑψηλότερος τῶν οὐρανῶν γενόμενος·

controles.web: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
controles.kjv: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
controles.livre: Pois nos era conveniente tal Sumo Sacerdote: santo, inocente, incontaminado, separado dos pecadores, e feito mais elevado que os céus;

versos.grego: ὃς οὐκ ἔχει καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀνάγκην, ὥσπερ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς, πρότερον ὑπὲρ τῶν ἰδίων ἁμαρτιῶν θυσίας ἀναφέρειν, ἔπειτα τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ· τοῦτο γὰρ ἐποίησεν ἐφάπαξ ἑαυτὸν ἀνενέγκας.

controles.web: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
controles.kjv: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
controles.livre: que não precisasse, como os sumos sacerdotes, de oferecer sacrifícios diariamente, primeiramente pelos seus próprios pecados, e depois pelos do povo. Pois ele fez isto de uma vez por todas quando ofereceu a si mesmo.

versos.grego: ὁ νόμος γὰρ ἀνθρώπους καθίστησιν ἀρχιερεῖς ἔχοντας ἀσθένειαν, ὁ λόγος δὲ τῆς ὁρκωμοσίας τῆς μετὰ τὸν νόμον Υἱόν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τετελειωμένον.

controles.web: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
controles.kjv: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
controles.livre: Porque a Lei constitui por sumos sacerdotes homens que têm fraqueza; mas a palavra do juramento, que veio depois da Lei, constitui o Filho, que se tornou perfeito para sempre.
